label: Back definition

range.endpoint_anchor: 1.0 = the source sculpt's own relief depth at the canonical station, frame-scaled to hm08 (closed-loop calibrated; see qa)

semantics: Back relief at value 1: canonical relief RMS 1.56 mm over the back profile (spinal furrow station reads 0.23 mm of it -- the source sculpt is mostly broad lat/scapular shaping). Pure relief; no back mass.

system.model: makehuman_hm08 relief field (sparse MakeHuman target, metres)
system.source: HIMBO - Body HPTorsoBackDefinition (SOS HP .osd twin of the SOS.osd block) transferred from the SOS HP base (14,597 verts, position-verified 1:1 over the Vanilla footprint; the Vanilla .osd carries no back-definition block and SOS-family sets do not index the Vanilla base) at the slider-lab feature kernel, closed-loop calibrated at the canonical relief-RMS station.
